name: Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur
positioning: Park Hyatt's first hotel in Malaysia, on the top floors of the Merdeka 118 tower above Stadium Merdeka, with restaurants on Level 75 and an infinity pool on Level 99
best_for: Travelers who want a high-rise city base near Chinatown with rail stations beneath the tower
Guests who value a spa with hydrothermal zones and a Level 99 infinity pool
Food lovers curious about Malaysian heritage recipes and chocolate-focused pastry

facts.text: Park Hyatt Kuala Lumpur occupies the top floors of Menara Merdeka Maybank, also known as Merdeka 118.
Merdeka 118 towers over Stadium Merdeka, where independence from the British was proclaimed in 1957.
The hotel is Park Hyatt's first in Malaysia.
Guests take lifts straight to the reception on the 75th floor.
The restaurants and bar, Park Lounge, Merdeka Grill and Cacao Mixology & Chocolate, are on Level 75.
At Merdeka Grill, dinner is served course by course, with signature dishes prepared or finished tableside.
Afternoon tea at Park Lounge features handcrafted pastries served from a dessert trolley.
The Bakery Bar inside Park Lounge offers cakes, pastries and signature chocolates by Executive Pastry Chef Holger Deh.
The spa has separate male and female hydrothermal zones with Himalayan salt chambers, aromatherapy steam rooms, experience showers and vitality pools.
Spa guests can create their own bath salts infused with locally sourced botanicals.
Chinatown lies less than a mile from the hotel.
Rail stations beneath the tower connect to the rest of the city.

highlights.text: Guest room interiors use Malaysian design accents and materials such as batik, songket and wood-carved motifs.
The infinity pool is on Level 99, lit by natural light through floor-to-ceiling windows.
Park Lounge serves Asian and Western comfort food alongside Malaysia's lost recipes.
The vanilla beans used in the hotel's desserts and chocolates come from Penang.

considerations.text: Kuala Lumpur International Airport is 58 kilometers from the hotel.
Hotel airport transfers require a 24-hour advance reservation.
